info.name: Laravel API Documentation
info.description: REST API for the Tazavera specialty coffee platform. Provides endpoints for managing coffee offerings, sensory evaluations (cupping), user profiles, and supporting taxonomies. Authentication is handled via Laravel Passport (OAuth 2.0) using the Authorization Code flow with PKCE for first-party clients and the Password grant for trusted clients.

Filter by producer name (max 150 chars). Must not be greater than 150 characters.
Filter by city (max 90 chars). Must not be greater than 90 characters.

request.description:
Returns coffee inventory items, each with coffee details (including
currently valid certifications) and roastery. Used by coffeeshops to
retrieve available coffees when creating an offering. Supports filtering
via query parameters.

Only non-expired certifications are included (those with no expiry, or an
expiry date in the future).

**Authorization:** requires the `coffeeshop` role and the `profile:read`
or `profile:write` scope.

request.description:
Returns the coffee catalog, each coffee with its currently valid
certifications. Supports filtering by name via query parameters.

Only non-expired certifications are included (those with no expiry, or an
expiry date in the future).

query.description: Filter by the coffee shop (business) name. Partial, case-insensitive match. Must not be greater than 150 characters.
Filter coffee shops with at least one location whose primary contact is in this city. Must not be greater than 90 characters.
Filter coffee shops with at least one location whose primary contact has this postal code. Must not be greater than 12 characters.
Filter by verified offerings: 1 returns only coffee shops with at least one verified offering in any of their locations, 0 only those without any. Omit it to return both.
Sort field. One of: name. Default: name.
Sort direction. One of: asc, desc. Default: asc.
Results per page (1–100). Default: 15, as GET /offerings. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.
Page number. Default: 1. Must be at least 1.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of coffee shops (businesses) that have at least
one location, each with its counters and all its locations (the map
shows every location of the filtered coffee shops). Only business data
is returned: never the owner's email, surname, personal contacts or
account data. Sorted by name ascending by default.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of the evaluations created by the authenticated
specialist, each including its taste notes (olfactory taxonomy references)
and the offering it belongs to. Supports the same filtering and sorting as
the public list, except the evaluator, which is always the authenticated
user.

**Authorization:** requires the `specialist` role and the `profile:read`
or `profile:write` scope.

Returns a single evaluation of the authenticated specialist with its taste
notes and associated offering. An evaluation that does not exist, or that
belongs to another user, returns `404 Not Found`, so the response never
reveals whether another user's evaluation exists.

**Authorization:** requires the `specialist` role and the `profile:read`
or `profile:write` scope.

response.name: Not found or not the owner

request.description:
Records a new sensory evaluation (cupping) for an offering. The evaluation
is created in the "open" state and must later be finalized via the close
endpoint. Returns the created evaluation with a confirmation message.

The request body carries three main blocks: `descriptive` (objective
assessment, scores 0–15), `affective` (preference assessment, scores 1–9),
and `extrinsics` (contextual metadata). See the body parameters and example
below for the full nested structure.

**Authorization:** requires the `specialist` role.

Updates an existing evaluation. Returns the updated evaluation with a
confirmation message. The body structure matches the create endpoint,
except `offeringId` is prohibited — an evaluation cannot be reassigned to
another offering.

A **closed** evaluation cannot be updated; attempting to do so returns
`409 Conflict`.

**Authorization:** requires the `specialist` role and permission to update
the evaluation (enforced by the evaluation policy). A specialist who does
not own the evaluation receives `403 Forbidden`.

response.body: {"message": "One or more evaluations do not belong to the user."}
response.name: Not the owner

request.description:
Transitions an evaluation to the **closed** state, finalizing it. A closed
evaluation can no longer be updated. No request body is required — the
evaluation is validated and closed using the data already stored.

The evaluation is only closed if it is complete. Completeness requires all
15 sensory scores greater than 0 (7 descriptive + 8 affective), plus at
least one taste reference for each of: main tastes, mouthfeel, and the
aromatic set (fragrance/aroma/flavor/aftertaste). If any is missing, the
request fails with `409 Conflict`.

If the evaluation is **already closed**, the endpoint returns `200 OK`
idempotently.

Closing dispatches an `EvaluationClosed` event, which recalculates the
offering's aggregate scores and concordance (via OfferingConsensusService).

**Authorization:** requires the `specialist` role and permission to update
the evaluation (enforced by the evaluation policy). A specialist who does
not own the evaluation receives `403 Forbidden`.

response.body: {"message": "One or more evaluations do not belong to the user."}
response.name: Not the owner

response.body: {"message": "Evaluation is incomplete, all scores need to be provided, and at least one cata attribute for each MainTastes, mouthfeel and the set of sensorial axis."}
response.name: Evaluation incomplete

request.description:
Permanently deletes an evaluation. This action cannot be undone.

**Authorization:** requires the `specialist` role and permission to delete
the evaluation (enforced by the evaluation policy). A specialist who does
not own the evaluation receives `403 Forbidden`.

response.body: {"message": "One or more evaluations do not belong to the user."}
response.name: Not the owner

sent, the other is required.

**Authorization:** requires the `coffeeshop` role and the `profile:write`
scope.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of coffee offerings, each including its taste
profile (olfactory taxonomy), coffee inventory (with roastery and coffee
details), and location. Supports extensive filtering and sorting via query
parameters.

Creates one offering per location for a given coffee inventory item. A single
request may target multiple locations; one offering is created for each,
all within a single database transaction (all-or-nothing).

**Authorization:** requires the `coffeeshop` role and the `profile:write`
scope. The authenticated user must own every location referenced
(`owns.location`).

Permanently deletes a single offering. This action cannot be undone.

**Authorization:** requires the `coffeeshop` role and the `profile:write`
scope. The authenticated user must own the offering (`owns.offering`).

Permanently deletes several offerings in one request, identified by their
ULIDs (maximum 50). This action cannot be undone.

**Authorization:** requires the `coffeeshop` role and the `profile:write`
scope. The authenticated user must own all referenced offerings
(`owns.offering`).

request.description:
Returns the roastery catalog. Supports filtering by name via query
parameters.

Returns the full olfactory taxonomy tree used to classify coffee aromas and
flavors. The tree is returned as a nested structure: top-level categories
(parent_id = null) with their children and grandchildren eager-loaded
(two levels deep).

Revokes all of the authenticated user's access tokens and their refresh
tokens, and ends every web session of the user on the server (the ones
opened by the OAuth login): their rows are deleted from the sessions
table and the remember token is regenerated, so a later authorization
asks for the login again.

**Authorization:** requires the `profile:read` or `profile:write` scope.

Creates a new user account and assigns the requested role. Public
registration endpoint. User creation and role assignment happen in a
single transaction; if role assignment fails, the whole operation is
rolled back.

Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.

**Authorization:** requires the `profile:read` or `profile:write` scope.

variable.description: The ULID of the authenticated user.

request.description:
Returns the contacts of the authenticated user (personal contact data,
not the contacts of their locations).

**Authorization:** requires the `profile:read` or `profile:write` scope
and the user must be the authenticated user (policy). Another user
receives `403 Forbidden`.

Updates a user's profile data. Returns the updated user with a
confirmation message.

**Authorization:** requires the `profile:write` scope and permission to
update this user (policy). A non-owner receives `403 Forbidden`.

Changes a user's password. The current password must be supplied and is
verified before the change is applied.

**Authorization:** requires the `profile:write` scope and permission to
update this user (policy). A non-owner receives `403 Forbidden`.

variable.description: The ULID of the authenticated user.

request.description:
Creates the primary contact of the authenticated user. A user has a
single primary contact: if it already exists the request fails with
`409 Conflict`. `isPrimary` is always set by the API, never taken from
the body.

**Authorization:** requires the `profile:write` scope and permission to
update this user (policy). Another user receives `403 Forbidden`.

Soft-deletes (deactivates) a user account; the account can be restored
later. Also revokes the requesting user's access tokens.

**Authorization:** requires the `profile:write` scope and permission to
delete this user (policy). A non-owner receives `403 Forbidden`.

Permanently deletes a user account (hard delete). This cannot be undone.
Also revokes the requesting user's access tokens.

**Authorization:** requires the `profile:write` scope and permission to
delete this user (policy). A non-owner receives `403 Forbidden`.
